actors.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
actors.role: Senator of Brazil and defeated presidential candidate
actors.blurb: Following his presidential election defeat, Flávio Bolsonaro remains at the center of international and domestic controversy after fleeing Brazil for Florida. His defense is actively appealing to Brazil's Supreme Federal Court to lift measures imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, while local law enforcement and international reports investigate allegations regarding his covert departure.
